director_authorization: The Director explicitly instructed Design Sol to continue the unfinished application-interface design after confirming that the existing architecture and Stage baseline were not a complete UI.

local_result.actions: PASS - primary action uses monochrome Primary/Field contrast; secondary uses functional boundary; quiet action may shed persistent border; high-consequence action uses stronger/double structure rather than a semantic hue.
local_result.inputs: PASS - bounded fields remain functional rather than identity-bearing; read-only uses explicit label plus dashed structure; invalid uses explicit corrective text plus stronger structure.
local_result.choices: PASS - checkbox/radio/switch selection may use accent reinforcement while keeping explicit state/label structure.
local_result.collections: PASS - rows remain quiet and separator-based; selection uses STA F2 edge witness; keyboard focus remains a separate outer ring.
local_result.disclosure_transients: PASS - disclosure remains progressive; menus/dialogs may use bounded surface and restrained functional elevation without replacing MAT F1 topology.
local_result.feedback: PASS - pending/read-only/unavailable/invalid states remain explicit and hue-independent.
local_result.responsive_accessibility: PASS - seven-case matrix survives 1600/1024/390/320, forced colors, 200% text and text-spacing stress with zero layout overflow and complete button naming.

authority_created: The APPUI foundational control grammar above is the default design-reference basis for Product-independent Kymaean application controls.
Primary action hierarchy is not teal; teal remains scarce selection reinforcement.
Functional control borders and transient elevation are permitted when they serve affordance/separation, but repeated card/tile chrome is not the component identity.
explicit_non_authority: No Product-gated Scene/Take/Rehearsal/provider/Performer control semantics are created.
No Stage successor or Stage behavior is changed.
No bespoke domain iconography, final icon asset package, typeface file, production token API or native WinUI/XAML mapping is created.
No shipping/runtime/Store accessibility validation is claimed.
Bellweather app-brand mascot visual authority is preserved as a separate integration input; this gate does not place or implement the mascot in app UI.
conclusion: PASS - a coherent Product-independent component foundation now exists above the frozen architecture/static visual system without reopening any closed APPUI visual decision.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION - CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
next_boundary: Open APPUI-COMP-02: apply this foundation to the actual application shell, durable scope/navigation, command regions and Production/resume workspace without inventing unresolved Product semantics.
